page_title: BAR 3-0 OSA | Barcelona v Osasuna 27/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Barcelona force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90' Pau Victor (Barcelona) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
89' A flowing move ends with a great cross into the centre of the box, which Ante Budimir (Osasuna) latches onto but sends a wild header well wide of the right post.
87' Pablo Torre (Barcelona) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
87' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Now Barcelona have a corner.
87' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Barcelona.

86' Pau Victor (Barcelona) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Sergio Herrera to get hold of the ball. Barcelona force a corner. They send men into the box.
85' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jesus Areso departs the field of play to be replaced by Ruben Pena (Osasuna).
84' Hansi Flick prepares a substitution. Pedri is replaced by Pau Victor (Barcelona).
83' That's the end of the game for Alejandro Balde, who is replaced by Gerard Martin (Barcelona).
79' That's a well-taken pass by Pablo Torre (Barcelona). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
77' 3 - 0 Goal! A great cross from Fermin Lopez finds Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), who scores with a simple header into an empty net. 3:0.
75' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) crashes a header just wide of the left post from close range after a searching cross. He should have scored!
75' A quickly taken corner by Osasuna.
72' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) commits a foul during an attacking move.
72' PENALTY APPEAL by Barcelona, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
71' Barcelona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
71' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) replaces Ferran Torres.
66' The ratio of the ball possession is 73:27.
62' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
62' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aimar Oroz trots off the pitch and is replaced by Moi Gomez (Osasuna).
60' Here is a change. Raul Garcia is going off and Vicente Moreno gives the last tactical orders to Ante Budimir (Osasuna).
59' Mateo Busquets blows his whistle after Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
58' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
57' Pablo Torre (Barcelona) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

57' Pablo Torre (Barcelona) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
57' Barcelona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
56' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Barcelona are going to take it.
54' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Flag goes up against Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
51' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) was too forceful with his tackle and Mateo Busquets interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
50' The linesman raises his flag. Ferran Torres (Barcelona) is adjudged offside.
50' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
50' The attendance is 42319.
49' Pablo Torre (Barcelona) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
48' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) loses his marker and gets on the end of the free kick, but he is unable to control the ball properly and sends his close-range header well past the left post.
47' Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul after Eric Garcia (Barcelona) hacks down one of his opponents.
46' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Gavi (Barcelona), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
46' Half-time substitution. Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) will not participate anymore and Pablo Torre is coming on.
46' Vicente Moreno has made a change at the break. Flavien Boyomo has come on in place of Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul.
45+3' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Barcelona was in an offside position.
45+1' That was close by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
44' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
43' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
42' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
40' Today's referee Mateo Busquets rightly decides to book Eric Garcia (Barcelona) for his harsh tackle.
39' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) takes a mid-range free kick and his stunning strike crashes against the crossbar.
38' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Mateo Busquets pulls out a yellow card.
38' The game is interrupted. Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
36' This shall not pass! Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
36' Referee Mateo Busquets sees the trip by Gavi (Barcelona) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
34' Vicente Moreno is forced to make a change. Iker Munoz (Osasuna) is unable to continue due to injury, Ruben Garcia comes on.
32' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) picks up an injury.
31' CLOSE! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the left post!
29' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
28' Hansi Flick is forced to make a change. Dani Olmo is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Fermin Lopez (Barcelona).
26' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
24' Osasuna fail to score from a corner as Wojciech Szczesny (Barcelona) leaps to collect the ball.
23' Osasuna work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
21' Goal! Dani Olmo (Barcelona) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Sergio Herrera into the bottom left corner.
20' Barcelona will get another bite of the cherry as the referee indicates the penalty must be taken again!
19' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the bottom left corner, but Sergio Herrera pulls off a superb save.
19' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) is going to take the penalty!
18' Mateo Busquets shows a yellow card to Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) for a tough tackle.
18' Mateo Busquets blows the whistle, Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) is penalised for a foul. Barcelona are given a penalty!
17' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
16' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
15' Barcelona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
14' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) pounces on the cross and fires in a shot on goal from close range, but Sergio Herrera is alert and makes a decent save. Barcelona get a corner.
13' Flag up against Juan Cruz (Osasuna). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
11' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Alejandro Balde plays it into the box, and Ferran Torres (Barcelona) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 1:0.
10' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) is adjudged offside.
9' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
8' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
6' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off his line to gather the ball.
4' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
2' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) is penalised for holding. Mateo Busquets signals a set piece.
1' A pass from Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is intercepted by Sergio Herrera and the move breaks down.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Barcelona will have the kick-off.
